subject: Rotational overlap plan: coding swarm coverage for Ethan Rogers
messages:
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ethan Rogers <ethan.rogers@gmail.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + rotational overlap plan for coding screen (Ethan Rogers)

Hi all — looping you in for a quick coverage plan. Ethan (cc'd) is confirmed for a 90-minute coding/ML pairing screen next Tuesday (Dec 1) at 10:00 PT. We have limited interviewer availability that evening across timezones, so I'd like to propose a rotational overlap model: two interviewers online for the first 45 minutes (problem walkthrough + live coding) and one interviewer stays for a 45-minute debrief/edge-case follow-up so we can deconflict notes.

Proposed interviewer roster:
- 10:00–10:45 PT: Kimberly Park (Frontend sampling) + Marcus Lin (Model evaluation)
- 10:45–11:30 PT: Marcus Lin (wrap + debrief)

Run of show attached (coding_problem.pdf) and Ethan's resume (candidate_resume.pdf). Platform: CoderPad link below.

Ethan — thanks again for being flexible. Please confirm you received the materials and that the time still works. If you prefer a different time window, tell us and we'll attempt a swap (we can do a backup at 6:00 PM PT).

Links and context: https://coderpad.io/p/xyz-rotational-swarm (pad includes hidden test cases, please don't open until the session)

- Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

2) Any language preference for the pad? I typically use Python but can switch.

Date: 2026-11-27T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + rotational overlap plan for coding screen (Ethan Rogers)

Thanks, Tessa — plan sounds good. Quick answers to Ethan's Qs:

1) We do not record live pairing screens by default; we take notes and share a short debrief. If you need recording for accessibility, we can enable it — let us know.
2) Python is perfect. If you'd rather use TypeScript, we can accommodate but the pad is pre-seeded with Python examples.

Logistics notes for the interviewers (internal):
- Marcus: please bring one micro-benchmark for model candidate evaluation (30–45s explanation).
- Kim: please have the frontend tracing task ready and a short prompt to seed the pad.
- Laura: can you own the post-interview rubric and consolidate notes with the hiring packet template?

I'll be online for the first 15 minutes to help onboard the candidate, then hand off to Marcus/Kim.

Thanks — see you all there.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Engineering Manager, Frontend
Redwood Inference
